summary: From fiscal 2007 to 2025, AMAZON.COM, INC. reported $4,599.1 billion of revenue and $144.8 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $133.9 billion, which leaves $10.9 billion of owner cash: 0.2% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 9 of 19 years.
In the 12 months to 2026-09-30 it was -8.4% of revenue.
